The search isn't over until every lead has been followed! In Expedition Bigfoot, a team of researchers combines field investigations, advanced technology and scientific analysis to track evidence of the elusive creature.
With every new clue, the team pushes further into the wilderness, examining strange signs and following leads that could bring them closer to an answer. As the investigation enters its final stretch, how close will they get to finding Bigfoot?
Watch Expedition Bigfoot, S1, Episodes 1, 2, 3, 4 & 5 and S4, Episodes 6, 1, 5, 7 & 2 on Discovery Channel India.
